title: factdiff.py review prints progress per source and names the fetch it waits on (it ran over 10 minutes silent in BG-rtqshnro)
goal: factdiff.py review on the facts of one to five sources prints progress per source and finishes, or names the fetch it waits on, within a bound stated in its usage text, so a worker does not stop it and read pages by hand (SP-df2cu4uj, BG-rtqshnro).

run:
import sys, io, re, types, subprocess, contextlib, collections
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import factdiff as fd
fd.ROOT = types.SimpleNamespace(name="public")
log = [dict(outcome="modified", source_id=s, path="a.md", fact="k%d" % i, line=str(i), url="https://example.com/" + s,
            verdict="changed", note="", target="") for i, s in enumerate(("S901", "S902"), 1)]
fd.read_log = lambda p: log
fd.sources = lambda: {s: {"url": "https://example.com/" + s} for s in ("S901", "S902")}
fd.cited_facts = lambda prefix=None: {}
fd.cite_counts = lambda f: {}
fd.read_anchors = lambda: {}
fd.provider.providers = lambda root: []
fd.old_passage = lambda *a, **k: (None, "")
fd.page_doc = lambda url, rows: (None, None)
fd.load_json = lambda *a, **k: None
a = types.SimpleNamespace(log="x", source=[], json=False, judge=False, dry_run=False, batch_size=None, model=None, max_budget_usd=None)
err, out = io.StringIO(), io.StringIO()
with contextlib.redirect_stderr(err), contextlib.redirect_stdout(out):
    fd.cmd_review(a, collections.Counter())
progress = all(s in err.getvalue() for s in ("S901", "S902"))
h = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/factdiff.py", "review", "-h"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
bound = re.search(r"\b\d+\s*(s|sec|secs|seconds|min|minutes)\b", h) is not None
sys.exit(0 if progress and bound else 1)
